The FixLog shows SL-9 attempted to repair the five unresolved fallback/termination events by changing the forced transitions from `::` to `:`. Therefore the target requests are not resolved.

The candidate DSL preserves the required states, variables, normal transitions, and actions, but the only diff changes event syntax on the five forced transitions.
